title: PhysMAS: Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthesis of Compositional 4D Gaussians
abstract: arXiv:2609.07174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient, fully automatic, and physically plausible 4D Gaussian synthesis is an important goal for dynamic scene generation. Recent physics-based methods couple 3D Gaussians with the Material Point Method (MPM) to generate physically driven motion, but extending this paradigm to heterogeneous multi-part objects and interacting multi-object scenes remains challenging. Object-level physical assignment collapses distinct parts into a single material state, while one-shot predictions from large language models, vision-language models, or agents neither reliably bind different materials to identified parts nor verify that the resulting MPM configuration is executable. translated_title: PhysMAS：基于物理的多智能体合成组合式4D高斯
translated_abstract: 高效、全自动且物理合理的4D高斯合成是动态场景生成的一个重要目标。近期基于物理的方法将3D高斯与物质点法（MPM）相结合以生成物理驱动的运动，但将这一范式扩展到异构多部件物体和交互式多物体场景仍然具有挑战性。物体级的物理分配会将不同部件坍缩为单一材料状态，而大语言模型、视觉语言模型或智能体的一次性预测既无法可靠地将不同材料绑定到已识别的部件上，也无法验证所得MPM配置是否可执行。同时，基于分数蒸馏采样（SDS）的参数优化需要对每个场景反复进行分数评估和梯度反向传播，导致优化过程漫长，并可能产生次优或不稳定的解决方案。因此，我们提出了PhysMAS，一种基于物理的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PhysMAS提出了一种基于物理的多智能体合成框架，通过可靠地将异构材料绑定到多部件物体的对应部件并验证MPM配置的可执行性，实现了高效自动且物理合理的组合式4D高斯动态场景合成。
en_tdlr: PhysMAS is a physics-grounded multi-agent synthesis framework that reliably binds heterogeneous materials to identified parts and verifies the executability of MPM configurations, enabling efficient, automatic, and physically plausible synthesis of compositional 4D Gaussians for dynamic scenes.
